scope: Offline Pythonic motion request capture and immediate scripted results; no physical motion or controller acceptance
capture: Validate complete finite operands and detach each in source order before evaluating the next; freeze PATH before range expressions and capture selected positional NODE_POS values
ownership: Explicit GroupLocks grants belong to the calling root across linked routines and programs; attach/release preflight complete selections, preserve foreign owners and clean released bindings at root termination
completion: Capture-only is an explicit opt-in with captured outcomes; otherwise consume a matching immediate completed/rejected response, without motion queuing or feedback updates
hands: Explicit one-based logical hand state, without port mappings or physical signals; hand actions may run in global handlers
persistence: Retain typed detached history, hand state and remaining scripts; validate bounded data and reject saves with live released-task bindings
